ai-product-video-cutter v1.0.0

- Initial release: Instantly cut e-commerce product videos into highlight clips using AI—no manual editing needed.
- Upload raw product footage (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM, up to 500MB).
- Simple workflow: upload, request highlight clips (e.g., "cut the best 30-second highlight clips"), and download 1080p MP4 output in about a minute.
- No installation required; processing runs on cloud GPUs.
- Designed for fast-moving e-commerce marketers needing quick, hands-off video trimming.
